notes.title: About that Goat: What is "fun" even?
notes.notes:
Now that we have established what the goat is, another question has been tantalizing our brains.
What is fun, even?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892310/b38cbf3f9ba40cf5732fec28e16ae975808d8e3f.jpg[/img]

Without further ado, tune in today at 4 PM CEST/ 7 AM PSD for another episode of...

[b]About That Goat[/b]

https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561198816253194

[i]From the creators of Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey, Midvinter and Kaleidocraft and publishers of Zestrea, comes a brand new telenovela about girl gamedev's! YOU, our fans, are the love interest and the resulting children are the games we make. Starring Laura the Professional Dragon and Queen Anna Hedgehogheart, this unique new Valiant production will Blown. Your. Mind.

What to expect: we will play Pendula Swing, talk about our life, studio, industry and struggles a lot and tell you uncensored stories about indie survival. Includes plans and updates for Kaleidocraft, tons of design chat, lots of brainstorming and the occasional drama when one of us won't have her way :D For as long as we survive as a studio.[/i]

notes.title: Spring Cleaning for our Summer Sales! Announcing discounts and improvements
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers!


We all contemplate a summer unlike any other, and it feels eerie that some things still go on as normal. Like the always much anticipated summer sales and offers, which hopefully will keep you safely entertained in this extra special year. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/6cd7b85ec1262669e05309ad5746c5c33f550cba.png[/img]

We gladly inform you that [b]Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey[/b] is part of the[url=https://summerofpride.tv/][b] MIDBOSS / SUMMER OF PRIDE 2020[/b][/url].  The [b]Summer of Pride[/b] is a month-long event of LGBTQIA+ streamers playing queer games, throughout the month of June. These fun “gaymers” will be playing some of the best and most unique games that showcase positive representation of queer characters and stories - like [b]Pendula Swing[/b], yay! 

To celebrate [b]Summer of Pride 2020[/b], there is an ongoing sale on queer-positive games, that will be available via the Chrono.gg storefront and on Steam from June 9-25. You can find [b]Pendula Swing[/b] on both these storefronts with a discount of 40%. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/579dfd2e23baefde9712513c259d177000233211.png[/img]
[list]
[*] There have been issues with item getting lost when you receive one with a full inventory. This should be fixed now. Please let us know if it still happens!
[*] The VIP guard at the Immigration Checkpoint used to have amnesia, and would not let you get into town a second time. We're happy to announce that she's now fully recovered, and should no longer insist on standing in your way.
[*] The issue with you not being able to finish the game if you left the area during the final part has been addressed and should be fixed. Again, let us know if anything is still bothering you about it!
[*] We've had issues with the dialogue with Jeff Wings - if you ask him about his brother, it could make you unable to ask him about the package that was delivered. While we respect his right to determine the topic of discussion, we've fixed some bugs with the dialogue and thereby hopefully made him a more cooperative goblin.
[*] We've had a report of a player being unable to give a permit to the goblin protester. While we weren't able to fully see why it happened, we've streamlined the dialogue a bit to hopefully fix it. 
[/list]

notes.title: 25% "Stay At Home" Discount for Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey
notes.notes:
As we promised last week, [b]Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey[/b] is now 25% off! Play a point & click adventure set in a fantasy version of the American Roaring 1920s where you can dance at the speakeasy, hang at the seedy bar, watch a movie at the cinema or go do some luxury shopping at the department store... safely! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/5b59082d7f6e42163ac22000318641b48912cd80.png[/img]

Furthermore, you can socialize with 400 unique and special fantasy 1920s characters and get as close to some of them as you want to. Have a potent dwarven ale and get to know some people. Date kind, shy goblins, virile orcs, jovial dwarves, beautiful elven ladies or fancy human ladies - your choice!  Pendula Swing offers you over 7 hours of content and hundreds of quests to complete. Oh - and pets. Lots of pets!

Enjoy [b]Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey[/b] from the comfort and safety of your home!

Anna& Laura

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/9b17d5d57d4a47bf9482c5bca9a22211a13a0e66.png[/img]

So if you are eager to explore a brand new 1920s city with fantasy vibes, filled with hundreds of characters you can get close to and socialize with, here is your chance! 

Enjoy!

Anna & Laura

notes.title: How many pets can you actually have in Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey?
notes.notes:
We had a cosy [b]Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey[/b] launch this Sunday  - stay tuned for the video footage from our very long [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCWU9X2td2NprvAj1KdEtAog]YouTube[/url] stream! For the very first time, we also broadcasted on Steam officially as devs and we were very happily surprised by the amount of adventurers interested in watching us play!

So, we decided to turn this into a habit. We will be broadcasting from the Valiant offices, [b]every other week on Tuesday, between 4pm to 5pm our time[/b] ([i]Stockholm, which is GMT+2; 4pm in Stockholm is 8am in San Francisco, but take that with a grain of salt because it is Laura here who's writing this, and I am a timezone disaster[/i]). 

Today we took the time to arrange our setup so next time we broadcast officially here, you will also be able to see and hear us. We have even made it so our official broadcasts appear officially on our official page! We do have hedgehog onesies that we use at the office and sometimes even when we are on stage, which we may be using....*

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/30d7404f07f26b8256148faa2cdd288e2bb98d4b.jpg[/img]

The fact that we broadcast officially every other Tuesday doesn't mean that we won't be broadcasting unofficially at random other times. But what an official broadcast means to us is something with a theme.[b] Next Tuesday, we will be gathering a lot of pets in Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey[/b] - and we will talk a lot about pets in general, both in game and real life. We might even show you pictures with our real life cats! 

What would YOU like us to broadcast and talk about?

See y'll next Tuesday!

Valiant Laura - [i]timezone disaster extraordinaire[/i]

* [i]the usage of hedgehog onesies cannot be guaranteed at this time[/i]

notes.title: Today's 42 is 3.1.1 - a patch with tiny fixes, thanks to your useful reports!
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers!

First and foremost, Thank You for being by our side this weekend, when our work for the past two years culminated in the launch of [b]Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey[/b]! While it feels like we have done a much better job with bug squashing*, some of you still found some tiny issues that we fixed. The patch is 3.1.1. Here's what we fixed:

[list]
[*] some of you experienced crashes in the Harbour District - this was likely due to the Police being overly active with prohibition, [i]probably because we stole their Chief's painting so many times[/i]; this should now be fixed 
[*] Jeff Wings occasionally lost himself in conversation, which prevented some of you to complete the main story line - he will pay more attention to you now, thus allowing you to move on
[*] Giglesh'Kern seems to be the sweetheart of Duberdon when it comes to dates, so we had a chat with him and taught him how to better shoot you gazes of love and ... well, he also decided to react if you still wear clothes when you're both in your bedroom. Right - [b]This Is Also A Spoiler Alert [/b]
[*] the invitation to your cousin's wake now also serves as an invitation to the city, so make sure you grab it when you leave home
[*] several characters have been... called to the principal's office and we taught them how to behave a little better
[*] we also fixed some typos, like the speakeasy' bartender's super sexy line "[i]this is a test text[/i]"
[/list]

We continue to keep an eye on your feedback! We are currently working in the Library to publish all the awesome content you sent to us, so we will be patching soon again!

*[i]as always, no real bugs were squashed during the development of this game[/i]

notes.title: Win a Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey key!
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Freshly Printed - Read All About It![/h1][/b]

The Goblins protests for their right to vote are on the rise! Police reports a worrisome increase in illegal Dwarven Ale trafficking, though when asked to show the confiscated barrels, the Police Chief shrugs and changes the subject. The Silver Gate Speakeasy keeps getting eviction and closure notices, but - let's be honest, everybody wants it open. 

[b]Tired of the News?[/b] The Great Library in the Academic District is now open to public. Featuring an impressive display of bookshelves, it only lacks one thing: more books. [h3]Are you the author we are looking for?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/795dd939c9aa22e4d57d346edcb45e5dd30317a1.gif[/img]

[b]The Great Library[/b] wants to publish selected books about subjects relevant to Duberdon and the Pendulan society in general. They accept any literary work of quality, fictional or not, as long as it complies with the following rules:
[list]
[*] short title mandatory; no more than 5 words
[*] a maximum of 1220 character or about 205 words
[*] no profanities; except for [strike]describing Jack The Flyboy[/strike] .... [i]nevermind[/i]
[*] polite, elegant language favoured
[/list]

Submissions to be done [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1230200/discussions/]on this community[/url], as comments to this [b]Important Announcement[/b] or under our [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1230200/discussions/0/1743395020137166457/]Library - Are you the author we are looking for?[/url][/b] thread. We may be lenient to those willing to start new discussions, especially if the story in question requires debate. 

The stories deemed most relevant to Duberdon and Pendula will be published and rewarded. One published story will be granted a special key that takes you to a magical land, all expenses paid. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/006cda66d01ac751f03309c7bd979ae85dfe3d4b.png[/img]

notes.title: A honest take at Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey extra features
notes.notes:
Noble Adventurers,

It's Laura here, Valiantly set to tell you about our special [b]Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey[/b] features and how you can use them to cause mischief to some Duberdonians that really deserve it. 
 
[b][h1]Fishing[/h1][/b]
Well, you can't really do any mischief with fishing. Except maybe starve some goblins. And goblins are really nice, don't you think? So for this particular feature, I figured I could give you a[b] top 3 worst fishing spots in Duberdon[/b]:

[olist]
[*] [b]The bench near the ice cream vendor in the Business District[/b]. Fish are notoriously known for getting scared, and the ice cream vendor, who is otherwise a very nice chap with very ... intriguing business decisions, yells about his ice cream [i]All. The Time[/i]. So if you fish there, you might get a headache. You do catch fish anyhow, because OUR fish don't get scared. And if you don't want an imaginary headache, you can make the poor ice cream vendor go away [i]and that's a little mischievous, maybe?[/i]
[*] [b] The stairs in the Harbour District.[/b] That's probably the most polluted water around, so there's a high chance of treasure, too. Also - you'll starve them poor goblins. The fish work just dandy for you because you are the hero and the protagonist, but trust me, if you fish there, those goblins will starve. And we have been mischievous enough to not [i]always[/i] allow you to give them your fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/bd625a74358761a53abd8671b73b0eb40ea1b801.gif[/img]

[*] [b]The bench in your neighbour's garden[/b]. We  understand your need for companionship, but fishing from your neighbours garden is illogical. Or maybe it isn't. I don't know! 
[/olist]

[b][h1]Decorating[/h1][/b]
In [b]Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey[/b], you can replace any art in your homes, and even some furniture. We call it "[i]decorating[/i]", but it can also be thought of as "[i]stealing[/i]". And I personally LOVE this feature because...  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/a1e96d201625043680bae96bc5678c7edb6667d6.gif[/img]

I stole the Police Chief's painting right from her office! She deserves it [i]so much[/i]!

The "decorating" feature can also be used as good old fashioned spam. Like so...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/c5c9b6eedd5eb0809885484e777b93d621845b7c.gif[/img]

I am pretty sure you'll find more mischievous ways to fish and decorate! I hope you enjoyed this! By the way - this is also me testing the Chat type of event. We are always here and on [b][url=https://discord.gg/jgFu7mc]Discord[/url][/b], ready to hear your feedback!

Laura
